company.name: Sobot
company.description: Sobot is a global leader in contact center solutions, offering a versatile platform that includes chatbot functionality, live chat, voice support, ticketing systems, messaging, and the WhatsApp Business API. Our mission is to provide a secure, adaptable platform that empowers companies worldwide to connect deeply and efficiently with their customers.From small startups to multinational enterprises, Sobot believes that every business should have access to innovative customer experience tools. Serving over 10,000 brands across diverse industries in 18+ languages, our clients include renowned names such as Samsung, OPPO, Philips, Tineco, DFS, Renogy, Weee!, Michael Kors, J&T, Air Liquide, OPay, Mico, and Lilith Games.

productsAndServices.description: An omnichannel contact center and customer service platform for managing customer interactions, support workflows, customer data, ticketing, live chat, CRM records, call center operations, AI automation, and analytics.
productsAndServices.name: Sobot Customer Service Platform

productsAndServices.description: An AI voice service for inbound customer support and outbound engagement, using speech recognition, NLP, LLMs, text-to-speech, multilingual processing, and human-agent handoff.
productsAndServices.name: Sobot Voicebot

productsAndServices.description: An outbound calling and telemarketing platform for lead reactivation, lead tracking, follow-up, surveys, campaign management, automated dialing, call recording, analytics, and AI-assisted sales conversations.
productsAndServices.name: Sobot Voice for Sales

productsAndServices.description: A mobile application for customer service teams to handle live chat, tickets, calls, CRM records, and service data remotely from smartphones.
productsAndServices.name: Sobot Mobile Office

productsAndServices.description: A WhatsApp Business API service for customer engagement, two-way communication, marketing, and support, integrated with Sobot’s omnichannel customer service platform.
productsAndServices.name: Sobot WhatsApp Business API
